description: Elections Commission - M. K. P. Dramajewa of the Beliatta Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Beliatta Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to ceasing membership in a political party. It is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by the Returning Officer, making it directly related to electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, which falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
